name: Keyword punch: highlighter, centred
when: One word or two the voice leans on: a highlighter stroke draws across them, centred in the lower third, then carries on off to the right.
anchor: The stroke (`at`) draws as the voice says the keyword.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.word: the keyword as the voice says it (the validated clip shows it in capitals: BY HAND)
vars.at: seconds after the start: when the stroke draws (the keyword's start in the voice)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when the stroke leaves (the scene ends 0.23 s later)

changed: The word and its time are values.
